notes: CHILD-AFTER-DEATH RESOLVED (folding in this repo's deep-chain credibility audit, 2026-07-04): Humphrey Bourchier died 14 Apr 1471 (killed at the Battle of Barnet) - real, documented (Wikipedia: Elizabeth Tilney, Countess of Surrey). The tree wrongly lists Thomas Howard (b.1473), Elizabeth Boleyn's mother (b.1480), and Muriel Knyvet (b.1485) as HIS children with wife Elizabeth Tilney - but all three were born from Elizabeth Tilney's SECOND marriage (30 Apr 1472) to Thomas Howard, 2nd Duke of Norfolk, after Bourchier's death. A classic tree-compiling error: collapsing a twice-married woman's two families into one. Bourchier and Elizabeth Tilney's real children were John Bourchier (2nd Baron Berners) and two daughters (see Margaret Bourchier's own record). See docs/research/ancestors/deep-chains-english-british-deep-chains.md.
